name: print-social-marketing-professionals-poster-black-white-line-illustration
title: 'Marketing Professionals At Your Service' poster in pure black and white with line-art figures
whatItMeans: Bold and sophisticated; pure black-and-white line art feels editorial and confident without needing any colour.
whatItIs: A black A4 poster with a rotated side label 'Poster A4 Flyer A5 Template Marketing', a bold white circled 'MARKETING' with 'PROFESSIONALS AT YOUR SERVICE', two-column body copy, a logo line, social icons, and white line-art illustrations of two people reviewing a presentation chart.
techniques: Restrict a poster entirely to black and white for editorial impact.
Circle the key word of a headline for emphasis.
Rotate a category label along the poster's edge.

vocabulary.definition: A design using only black, white and greys.
A person illustrated using only outline strokes.
